title: A module sheaf morphism locally bijective on sections is an isomorphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M,N$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\varphi:M\to N$. If every $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $V$ such that $\varphi(W)$ is bijective for every open $W\subseteq V$, then $\varphi$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Forget to sheaves of abelian groups. Given two sections with equal image, intersect their domain with the prescribed neighbourhood of each point. Bijectivity on that intersection gives equality locally, proving local injectivity.

Given a target section, intersect its domain with the prescribed neighbourhood of each point. Surjectivity gives a local preimage. Apply Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso to obtain an isomorphism of abelian sheaves, then reflect isomorphisms through Modules.toPresheaf.
